analysis.summary: Caller has a slow kitchen drain, not an emergency. Booked a drain cleaning visit for Monday at 10 AM.

artifact.transcript:
AI: Thanks for calling Tidewater Plumbing, this is the after-hours line. How can I help?
User: Hi, my kitchen sink is draining really slowly.
AI: Is any water overflowing or leaking onto the floor right now?
User: No, it's just slow.
AI: Okay. I have Monday, November 23 at 10 AM or Tuesday, November 24 at 9 AM. Which works better?
User: Monday at ten.
AI: You're booked for Monday, November 23 at 10 AM. You'll get a text confirmation.
